CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS credentials (
 id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
 name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
 url VARCHAR(500),
 username VARCHAR(255),
 secret_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL,
 notes TEXT,
 client_id INTEGER REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 updated_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CONSTRAINT ck_credentials_secret_encrypted CHECK (secret_encrypted LIKE 'v1:%')
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_credentials_client_id ON credentials (client_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS credential_shares (
 credential_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES credentials(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 PRIMARY KEY (credential_id, user_id)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_credential_shares_user_id ON credential_shares (user_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS credential_access_log (
 id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
 credential_id INTEGER REFERENCES credentials(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 credential_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
 user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 action VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
 detail VARCHAR(500),
 at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CONSTRAINT ck_credential_access_log_action CHECK (action IN ('reveal','copy','create','update','share','delete'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_credential_access_log_credential_at ON credential_access_log (credential_id, at)
